tools.name: get-biggest-drops
tools.description: Get today's biggest tracked price drops on Amazon United Kingdom, ranked by drop size. Returns up to 12 products with current price, previous price, drop percentage and their Tosheroon URL.

tools.name: open-search-results
tools.description: Search Tosheroon's tracked Amazon catalogue by keywords, brand or Amazon URL and open the results page.

query.description: Search keywords, a brand name, or an Amazon product URL

tools.name: track-amazon-product
tools.description: Start tracking an Amazon product on Tosheroon: paste an Amazon product URL (or search keywords) and this opens its price-tracking page with full price history, forecasts and alerts.

query.description: An Amazon product URL (any Amazon domain) or search keywords
